sections: Dr. Ada Vale never made it back to Cinder. Speak to Marshal Bell, follow the two clues east, and bring the doctor and her medicine home. You can negotiate, sneak, or fight.
Care for your horse, Flint. Gather yarrow, hunt or fish, cook at camp, trade at the store, play twenty-one at the saloon, or explore the mine. All are optional; your journal records them.

Fire aims at the nearest visible hostile with Aim assistance on. Focus slows time and exposes tracks. Reload your six-shooter. Crouching behind walls breaks sight; a lasso or silent takedown can spare a life. Ordinary townsfolk are protected; firing in town still brings the law.
Checkpoints save automatically in this browser. Continue restores the latest checkpoint. Falling in battle lets you retry without losing the mission. Saves remain local to this device.
